unit: brand/person; one immutable study across all marketing journeys

assignment.allocation: SHA-256(canonical JSON [seed,brand,person]), first unsigned 64 bits < 2^63 → treatment
assignment.reassignment: forbidden across versions/epochs; no automatic release

window: [assigned_at, assigned_at + 604800); observation as_of is separate from event effective time

metrics.assigned: All persisted assignments visible as_of; denominator never filtered on post-assignment eligibility or acceptance.
metrics.eligible_at_assignment: Frozen pre-action lifecycle eligibility; snapshot fingerprint retained. Current dispatch eligibility is reevaluated.
metrics.approved: Distinct assigned people with exact-action approval history visible as_of.
metrics.accepted: Distinct assigned people with matching action id and exact payload fingerprint in independently reconciled receipt history. Not contact or deliverability.
metrics.holdout: Assigned holdout; dispatch suppresses every competing marketing journey.
metrics.conversion: At least one latest-revision positive CRM conversion with matching brand/person and effective time inside the window. Not attributed to delivery.
metrics.activation: Not separately instrumented: generic product activity does not establish a qualified activation milestone. No activation-rate claim.
metrics.mature_covered: Window ended as_of AND one latest source coverage assertion spans the whole window; no record absence assumption.
metrics.itt_rate_difference: Treatment conversions/all treatment assigned minus holdout conversions/all holdout assigned, only when both arms nonempty, all assignments mature/covered and no exposure integrity exceptions.
metrics.received_subgroup: Conversions among independently accepted people divided by accepted people; descriptive selection, never a randomized/causal estimate.
metrics.uncertainty: Difference of approximate Bonferroni-adjusted 97.5% Wilson bounds (z=2.241403), reported as conservative approximate joint 95% interval. Small synthetic sample; no power or significance claim.
metrics.pipeline_cents: Latest explicit synthetic USD opportunity sources linked by exact brand/person/conversion_ref; each source counted once. No campaign attribution inferred.
metrics.incremental_commercial_revenue: null. No invoice, payment allocation, recognized revenue or causal commercial bridge in this study.

revision_rules: Select highest revision observed <= as_of BEFORE effective window and positive conversion filters. Duplicate source versions are idempotent; identity rebinding/collisions rejected.
suppression: Frozen assignment never authorizes execution. Current consent, owner, commercial state, coverage, contact limits and exact approvals remain mandatory. New effects stop at window end; historical receipt reconciliation remains permitted.
simulation: Person ordinal divisible by 3 has one positive day-1 CRM conversion, observed at day 7; first person corrected to false one second later. Neither arm nor acceptance influences this rule. One explicit USD 125000 pipeline source and one USD 9000 missing-link source exercise reconciliation.
boundaries: Local synthetic fixture and loopback destination. No native vendor, actual communications, real financial outcomes or measured commercial lift.
